questions.stem: Considering neural conduction, a neuron's absolute refractory period lasts 1 ms. In 10 ms, what is the maximum number of action potentials if each takes 1 ms plus 1 ms recovery?
questions.explanation: Each spike cycle is 2 ms, so 10/2=5 spikes. Using 1 ms per spike would give 10, ignoring recovery.
questions.hint: Divide total time by cycle length.
